description: App-command grants for pack popups (`popup-*`, plan SK2-A5: Xfire's Infoview, StealthX's main menu), each beside the skin window that launched it. The popup renders the served popup shell through the same skin tree as its launcher (`src/windows/SkinPopupWindow.tsx`), so it runs its nodes' actions (`run_skin_action`) and reports its selection (`set_skin_selection`); the event stream and skin read come from `app-baseline.json`, the window chrome from `default.json`. It opens no windows and no popups of its own. No plugin grants.
